_doc: Gary Tan (Garry Tan) design principles, bridged through gstack plan-design-review, mapped to NFRI editorial index. Consumed by DESIGN.md and skills/nfri-design-review.

sources.gstack: ~/.claude/skills/gstack/plan-design-review/SKILL.md — Design Principles (1–9), Cognitive Patterns, UX Principles (Krug)

garry_tan_core.name: Delabel yourself
garry_tan_core.statement: Design is applying simple proven principles — no permission slip required.
garry_tan_core.nfri: Editorial research UI is design work. Use tokens and pipeline files; don't defer to 'someone else's job'.

garry_tan_core.name: Empathize (novice simulation)
garry_tan_core.statement: Run the user simulation with zero builder context. Sand down the edges where people get caught.
garry_tan_core.nfri: Assume the reader has no methodology context. Gate banner, kickers, and scatter axes must explain state without insider jargon.

garry_tan_core.name: Illuminate the path
garry_tan_core.statement: Use contrast and hierarchy so users see what matters first. Copy is UI — text and elements explain what's happening and what's next.
garry_tan_core.nfri: `.type-kicker` → `.type-display` → `.type-lead` scan order. Provisional gate copy states coverage honestly. Section kickers label the argument beat before the chart.

garry_tan_core.name: Minimize the non-essential
garry_tan_core.statement: Remove chartjunk and ornamentation so meaningful elements earn attention.
garry_tan_core.nfri: Flat panels, hairline rules, no shadows/glass/pill toggles. If a chrome element doesn't serve the dataset or argument, cut it.

garry_tan_core.name: Create (contrast, closeness, grids)
garry_tan_core.statement: Organize with contrast, proximity, and grids — interaction design translated into visual structure.
garry_tan_core.nfri: Segmented `.filter-seg` groups related controls. `.panel` + ruled grids for stats. Semantic quadrant colors only on scatter/pills.

garry_tan_extended.statement: Copy and UI work together; users have no creator context.
garry_tan_extended.nfri: Hero lede, gate stats, drawer labels, and essay register must stand alone — no 'as you know' copy.

garry_tan_extended.statement: Power without clutter — optional depth behind links and drawers.
garry_tan_extended.nfri: Index summary on page; methodology and record detail in drawer/essays. Don't dump the appendix into the masthead.

garry_tan_extended.statement: UI should show examples, not leave users guessing format.
garry_tan_extended.nfri: `design-system.html` gallery and `/?v=design-system` are the reference specimens — ship patterns there first.

garry_tan_extended.statement: Watch users fail silently, then fix sharp edges — no shortcut.
garry_tan_extended.nfri: Preview at localhost:8765; three-agent review against DESIGN.md + live index before calling a surface done.

gstack_design_principles.nfri: Zero-result filters and empty quadrants need a ruled empty state with context — not a blank panel.
One display line, one lead, then instruments. Competing hero elements fail the scan test.
Name tokens (`--type-title`, `--accent`), not 'clean modern'. Changes go through `design_system.json`.
Long firm names, provisional tiers, partial coverage — design for them in table/scatter, not as afterthoughts.
No dark grid heroes, glass docks, Playfair+Inter, glow CTAs — see DESIGN.md Don't list.
Masthead and scatter reflow with purpose; not 'stacked desktop'.
Contrast on paper tokens, keyboard filters, `prefers-reduced-motion`, touch targets on `.filter-seg`.
Default action is remove chrome. Add only when the dataset or argument requires it.
Honest gate percentage from `authoritative_share`; provisional labeling; no synthetic stats in UI.

gstack_learnings_seed.insight: NFRI stores Gary Tan core principles (empathize, illuminate, minimize, create, copy-is-UI) in contract/design_principles.json, bridged to gstack Design Principles 1-9. Review via skills/nfri-design-review/SKILL.md.
NFRI editorial index: subtraction default — flat panels, hairline rules, no vibecode heroes/glass/shadow cards (Gary Tan minimize + gstack #5 #8).
NFRI trust at pixel level: honest gate from authoritative_share, provisional tier labels, no synthetic stats (gstack #9 + copy-is-UI).
